comments: Reyes' apartment was absolutely as advertised, very easy to get to either by taxi or public transport and nice and quiet tucked away in the streets of Poble Sec. Plenty of natural light and a nice spot to chill out before heading into the centre of Barcelona

La casa está muy bien, muy cerca del paralelo y de varias calles con muchos bares y restaurantes, pero lejos del bullicio y el ruido. La casa es muy agradable, tranquila, y la relación calidad precio es excepcional. Está muy bien equipada para sentirte como en casa. Toni es un gran anfitrión, puntual, amable y cumplidor. Si vas a BCN es una opción muy muy recomendable.
Great communication, clean place and easy living like the locals.
Très bon séjour et logement correspondant à la description. Je recommande

Cozy studio apartment perfect for a couple. Very close to the metro but we opted to walk most places. Clean and the AC works great! Wifi is fast and check in was very straightforward and quick. Professionalism of a hotel at airbnb prices!

Xavier's place was extremely clean, in a great location and with stunning sea and coastal views!  It was actually much more ample than it appeared in the photos and I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again.  It was also great that it was on the top floor and we didn't have people above us.  The only downside to the area is that the streets around the building can smell really bad sometimes.  This is nothing that the host can remedy, but one should be prepared that the streets of Poblenou can really stink in places : (

As a young couple, we really enjoyed our stay here! The appartment was very well located and the area was amazing (lovely spots to have a drink or to eat). The place was very clean & communication with Georgina went very fluent. We recommend this place!
Julia is very friendly! The room fits the description. It really is very conveniently located. The whole apartment is very nice, cozy and clean.  I had no problems. Thank you!
El edificio es antiguo, pero la ubicación es muy enérgica y concurrida. Limpio.
todo perfecto

We spent a week in this nice home in April 2019.
Very clean, great communication from Lia (a great host) and a short stroll to the Metro and hundreds of food options.
You’ll never go hungry in Barcelona!
The house is a little away from the hustle and bustle of La Rambla and that suited us just fine.
Would not hesitate to return if the opportunity presented itself.

We visited during the mobile world Congress and this impacted the price for us. overall very good property. very clean, it's important. everything works well. good surprise there was a proper Italian espresso stove top coffee maker, fully equipped kitchen. one thing that we found unoptimal is that window from second bedroom looks into the stairs and elevator, basically internal window.

Roger and Flor were very welcoming and helpful, always available to contact when necessary. The apartment was extremely well kept and even nicer than in the photos! Perfect location for me as I was working around the corner. The surrounding area is lovely, with some great restaurants and bars nearby, but the apartment is quiet. Also very close to metro station and easy to get into central Barcelona. Would definitely recommend.

Wir fanden alles so vor, wie es beschrieben war. Das Apartment war hell und sauber, nicht weit vom Meer entfernt. Es liegt in der Nähe des wie ich finde wunderbaren Viertels Poble Nou. Unsere Gastgeberin war gut erreichbar, hat zuverlässig und zügig auf meine Anfragen geantwortet, und war immer hilfsbereit und freundlich.
Departamento bien ubicado,  acceso a transporte ( metro o autobús), cerca de puntos de visita, y un plus, con un elevador histórico.

This family of four including 2 teenage girls loved this apartment. Brilliant just out of centre location with loads of great local independent shops. Space was very good, spacious, airy, had air con and all amenities. We would not hesitate to recommend.

Tutto perfetto. Comunicazione ottima. L'appartamento è coerente la descrizione. Attorno ci sono negozi di cibo biologico, market, supermarket e un'ampia scelta di locali. La metro è a 5 minuti a piedi.

The place is great. Very big and has all your needs. Looks just like the pictures. Lola is very helpful and will always answer when you need her. The location is good near shops and restaurants, not a bad walk to la Ramblas either. It is on the top floor but the building has a little elevator.
We had a great time, we thank you for everything
Todo bien!
很好的体验，就是热水器容量过低，无法连续支持三人淋浴

Apartment Hotel in angenehmen Viertel.
Alles hat geklappt- einen besetzten Empfang vorzufinden war sehr angenehm. Weiter so!
The best apartment in Barcelona and he is helpful many thanks
Très bon emplacement, agréable et calme
Hôte très accueillant et réactif. Logement propre et agréable
Muy buen hostel! lo recomiendo

サグラダファミリアに近く、とても清潔で快適に過ごせました。
チェックインはとても丁寧でした。
このアパートをおすすめします。
Nice staff, good location, good price for value

Appartamento completamente ristrutturato pulito e silenzioso adatto ad una famiglia di 5 persone come noi. A due passi dalla fermata metro e dintorni graziosi nel quartiere Gracias. Tutte le procedure di check in ed ingresso all appartamento on line. A volte ho trovato complicato entrare nella palazzina. Tutto sommato un buon soggiorno. Se rivado a Barcellona ci tornerei

Me and my husband stayed here for our recent honeymoon for 3 nights and we absolutely loved the apartment. We were met by one of Mari's friends who was very welcoming and congratulated us and there was a bottle of wine and chocolates waiting! The location is just amazing, just 1 minute from Sagrada and metro line. We stayed here for 3 days and we didn't want to leave!! The apartment itself is stunning, so so beautiful.
We will definitely stay here again when we come back!!

It was great to stay at this apartment, and Rosario was flexible to accommodate our needs. You have most of what you need around the apartment, and it is accessible to the city centre. Highly recommended!

Nous avons beaucoup communiqué avec la personne qui gérer L'appartement avant notre arrivée, elle a était super cool , état très pro .
L'appartement est jusque wouah ,très grand et très jolie , lit au carré, serviettes et kit de salle de bain a disposition, nous étions 6 personnes donc 4 enfants qui on beaucoup aimé aussi, le quartier propose énormément de restau , supermarché... très bien situé, je recommande et nous reviendrons
Me and my friends had a wonderful stay, the apartment provided a great base camp for exploring the city and a good place to recharge after a long day of walking.
La verdad la estadía fue muy linda el lugar super recomendable, lo volvería alquilar sin dudas. El lugar super tranquilo, seguro, a mano todo. La verdad la pasamos hermoso muchas gracias  Neus...
la vista hermosa todo estaba cerca una experiencia agradeble volvería de nuevo
Sehr nett kleine Wohnung mitten in Barcelona. Dazu auch noch sehr nette Gastgeber, die bei jedem Problem direkt bereit stehen.
Cool apartment in great location
El depto cumplio con las expectativas hcumplió con las expectativas que teniamos todo muy limpio y con todo lo que necesitabamos para estar cómodos.

Great location for exploring Barcelona.  Apartment with all amenities.  The windows overlook the courtyard, so there is no street noise.  There is an elevator, which is important.  Communication with the owner was excellent.  A very pleasant person.
Logement propre très bien placé et procédure d’arrivée simple.

Jordi is a very gracious host.   When we arrived at the address, he was already there.  He showed us around the spotless apartment (which has excellent air conditioning), after which he gave us a thorough overview of Barcelona's best attractions.  The nearby neighborhood square is a wonderful introduction to Spanish culture, with entire families gathered to talk and sip coffee in the early evening.
This is definitely good value for money! Place was clean and nice and it totally fit photos and description. I would recommend it!

Such a great host. Oliver took his time introducing us to the apartment and the city in a very relaxed manner….and even organized a taxi to the airport at the end of our stay. Loved the location, a little bit removed from the heavily touristy area. Seemed to be lots of locals walking and dining there. Plus it was within walking distance to the Sagrada and not so very far from other sites. Be sure to visit the Palau de La Musica!
Location was perfect!
We loved the location!

Would highly recommend staying at this apartment in Sants! Perfect location and very cosy place, with great facilities and in a quiet neighbourhood. Phil & Fiona were very helpful. Enjoyed my stay!! Will be back again for sure!
Tivemos dias maravilhosos no apartamento do Mário! Adoramos tudo e voltaremos vom certeza!

Our stay at Silvia and Luís’s apartment was excellent and exactly what we’d hoped for. The apartment is in a lovely area with a gorgeous view, and the apartment itself was spotless. The hosts were really responsive and super helpful and understanding. I would definitely recommend staying here.
Todo perfecto! Mari es encantadora, esta al lado de la sagrada familia, super centrico, y la casa es muy bonita y confortable, muy limpia con todos los detalles para estar bien! un 10!!!

We loved our stay in this beautiful, spacious Barcelona apartment! It’s a 3rd-floor walkup, so be prepared for stairs. The colorful tiled floors, large windows, and natural light made it perfect for relaxing siestas. The well-equipped kitchen and big dining table were great for family meals, and the TV kept the kids entertained after long days exploring. The nearby train station was closed for repairs, but the V19 bus, a block away, goes straight to the old town and Barceloneta beaches. The safe, vibrant neighborhood has a Brooklyn-like feel with cool boutiques and lively squares. The hosts were responsive, polite, and provided excellent guides. Highly recommend!
Great place. Nice and central as a base for Barcelona and beyond. Plaça d’Espagna 2 mins away connects you to anywhere you need to go. Would stay again.

Beautiful apartment. Excellent location.  Just next to the metro. We stayed for nights and it was perfect.  Only thing was the water in the shower goes down slowly on the drainage hence you will need a few mins in between showers.  Sofia was not there to meet us but her brother was really helpful.
Sehr gut geeignet für 4 Personen, 2 Schlafzimmer, 2 Bäder, Küche um etwas zuzubereiten, zentrale Lage, ausgezeichnet.

Loved it so much I added a couple extra nights. A block away from Gaudi’s Casa Mila. Two blocks to Diagonal metro stop to get you anywhere in town within a few minutes. High-end shopping a block away. Great restaurants nearby. To top it all off the ground floor of the hotel is a full bakery and coffee shop. Perfect way to spend a week — or a few days — in Barcelona.

Jordi’s apartment is the best. Everything you need is available at the apartment or in the area. We love the Poblenou area and Jordi provided us with great spots to go to. Great, effective and pleasant communicatie
The only negative point: the mattress is thin as ice. For the rest the apartment is perfect and we would love to come back once the mattress has been renewed :)

The place was exactly like the pictures, location is perfect, views are amazing. They accommodated us with a crib, and they were really helpful with recommendations. It is a beautiful apartment full of character. You have everything you need within walking distance.

My family and I had a great time, and the home was perfect!  Unfortunately, our trip started off rough as our flight was canceled.  Luckily, we got another flight that was close and didn’t impact our schedule too much.  Henrik was responsive and provided the right info to coordinate with his property manager to help us get settled in even though we arrived the morning after.  The location is excellent with some great grocery markets, restaurants and and bars all within close proximity.  Thanks for your part in making our trip great!

Merci à vicky pour son accueil. L'emplacement était très bien. L'appartement est très propre et très agréable. Nous avons garer la voiture à montjuic, les emplacements sont gratuits. Il faut chercher un peu mais c'est possible, c'est à 15 min à pied de l'appartement. A refaire. Très bonne adresse.
César is a great host and everything went very smoothly! Area is safe and silent with loca inhabitants. You can buy Fresh bread from downstairs for
Die Unterkunft liegt sehr zentral nahe der Rambla. Es war super sauber & die Kommunikation mit den Gastgebern war sehr einfach. Vielen Dank!

Marcelo’s place is right in the heart of the city but still was quiet. We had to figure out how the A/C and heat worked. Great water pressure. We checked in a couple of hours early because the cleaner let us in and she was just finishing up.
5 minute walk to the La Sagrada Familia and the metro.
Overall great.
Die Wohnung war super gelegen und schön und praktisch eingerichtet. Wir haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt.
The apartment was great, location was quiet but still walking distance from so much. The rooftop terrace was a beautiful space to enjoy the sun and soak in some views. We had a great stay

Très bonne communication par messages avec Alex (la personne qui gère l’accueil) avant notre départ et le jour de notre arrivée; agréable et efficace.
Logement idéalement situé à côté de la Plaça Reial et du Palau Güell.
Métro Drassanes juste à côté sur la Rambla.
A beautiful and spotlessly clean apartment, lovely white bedding and towels. Would stay here again. Thank you Alex
Perfect location and amazing apartment. Very happy with my stay here.
Very nice appartement and perfect location!!! Thank you😁
Great location. Walking distance to Sagrada Familia. Nice to have a balcony. Even though our flight was delayed Vero waited for us at the apartment. All in all an enjoyable stay.

While the view is nice, the apartment clearly was not ready for guests and should have been inspected before allowing guests to stay. The shower knob in the master bedroom was missing, rendering it useless and forcing 4 of us to share the hall bathroom. Both bathrooms have a smell of sewage. The water boiler was not turned on prior to our arrival, so we were forced to turn on the boiler ourselves.
The strangest part: after the check-in person showed us how to turn on the TV, the remote went missing. We turned the entire apartment upside down to no avail. When I messaged the check-in person if he or the cleaner had seen it, they said they would check with the cleaner. I didn’t get a response until one day, the remote suddenly appeared, but without any warning someone would be entering the apartment with our belongings and documents. The host at least offered to send a repair person, but these items should have been inspected for prior to renting to guests.

Ik was in Barcelona voor 4 nachten met 2 vrienden voor een bruiloft. We zijn 26 jaar oud en al een keer of 10 in Barca geweest, hier mijn plus en minpunten:

+ Locatie. Gracia is een gunstig liggende wijk. Overal redelijk vlakbij, Barca is nou eenmaal een grote stad dus vrijwel alles moet met metro of taxi. Zit paar meter lopen op een supermarktje + bank.
+ Appartement. Zoals de foto's eruit zien, is het appartement. Strak en schoon. Wij waren met zijn drieën en vonden het een top appartement.
+ Contact ging via Romina, prima contact. Reageerde snel en vriendelijk.
+ Sleuteloverdracht werd gedaan door een collega, die ons daarna gratis afzette bij de pub Michael Collins. Erg vriendelijk!

- Inchecken tussen 20:00-23:00 is €30 en na 23:00 is €50. Hoewel Romina mij hier wel op wees nadat ik mijn reisgegevens opstuurde, vind ik de regel onzin.
- De badkamer wordt redelijk snel nat op de grond en daardoor vies. Een van mijn vrienden heeft het drooggemaakt met de handdoeken. Maar deze handdoeken waren wit, dus erg vies geworden. Hier hebben ze €30 voor gerekend. Niet onredelijk, maar misschien wat veel voor 2 simpele witte handdoeken. Zou fijn zijn als er even een trekker of iets komt te staan waar de badkamer wel mee drooggemaakt kan worden.
- In de slaapkamer waar twee eenpersoonsbedden staan, zijn de bedjes vrij simpel. Simpel bed + matras erop. Stoorde mij niet, slechts noemenswaardig.

Al met al: top appartement! Zou er absoluut nog een keer verblijven.

We enjoyed our stay in Barcelona. Our keypad code wasn’t working when we got there but Marta was very responsive and had great communication, she took care of it right away. The only other con was that you can’t take a shower without the whole bathroom floor and shower mat getting soaking wet due to there not being a shower door which is a design that works well with large bathrooms/showers but not this small space. Otherwise, the place was great.

The convenient location, fabulous support from the host and of course the really well set up apartment that was everything that was promised made this the perfect spot for our stay in Barcelona. We ate at a number of his recommended food spots and they were great. Easy and pleasant walk to Sagrida Familia, really convenient to 2 metro stations. We even caught the metro to the airport on our way home. Worked well.

방이 정말 깨끗하고 침구류도 정말로 깨끗합니다
화장실이 공용이라는게 좀 불편했던것 빼고 위치나 청결도는 굉장히 뛰어납니다

Bel appartement spacieux, bien équipé et très bien situé.
Excellent restaurant au pied de l’immeuble.
Je recommande sans hésitation
Ubicación perfecta tienes muchos bares,supermercados al rededor y bancos. muy cerca de la sagrada familia y del metro para moverte a cualquier zona. El apartamento bonito y limpio.
Sehr schöner Aufenthalt. Tolle Dachterrasse. Uns hat nichts gefehlt.

The apartment was very clean & centrally located. We used FreeNow to get around.
The is a Lidl near by so you can buy your groceries & cook.
The host was very friendly.
If I visit Barcelona I would like to stay there again.
Very nice apartment. Very near to metro, sightseeing places. Good eating places nearby. We had a great time
Very nice place! The room is great, very clean, they change the towels everyday and the staff is super helpful.
Lovely apartment, very clean, neighbours could sometimes be heard
Metroya yakındı, tüm ihtiyaçlarımızı karşıladı

Loved Barcelona and Fabrice's place was perfect. In walking distance to many restaurants and popular spots in the city. We had such a great time. Fabrice was honestly the best host possible. Loved it.

We really enjoyed our stay here! Very modern-looking, cozy apartment. It was very clean and our overall stay here felt safe with a few security features in place at night. Happily the location turned out to be in close proximity to the Metro, many shops and cafes and attractions. The apartment even has the simple luxuries like a Smart TV with netflix etc. I’d highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Barcelona.
Very helpful and attentive hosts with Checkin. Easy access to metros and taxis, very walkable and lots of bedrooms, good for groups! The patio and and AC in every room was lovely.

Ne-am simtit ok, locuinta a fost ca in descriere, cu toate dotarile necesare.
Posibilitatea checkinului inainte de ora indicata ne-a incantat, deoarece am ajuns devreme si am putut lasa bagajele. Zona a fost destul de linistita , destul de aproape de obiective , acces rapid la statiile de autobuz sau metrou.
De asemenea este un supermarket util si foarte aproape. Pe partea de curatenie ar mai trebui lucrat.. sub pat era foarte mult praf , gunoaie, obiecte pierdute ( am fost cu copii mici care bagau jucarii pe acolo, de aceea am observat acest aspect)
Отличная квартира с прекрасным расположением .

We had an absolutely wonderful stay! 🌟 Jesus is truly one of the best hosts we’ve ever met. From the very beginning, he greeted us warmly at check-in and even took the time to walk us around the neighborhood, pointing out essential stores, restaurants, and hidden gems nearby. That personal touch made us feel right at home right away.
The apartment itself was spotless, modern, and equipped with all the amenities we needed. We especially appreciated the thoughtful welcome snacks waiting for us in the fridge. The location couldn’t have been better — a safe, quiet, and charming neighborhood just a 15–20 minute walk to La Sagrada Familia and other main attractions in Barcelona.
Whenever we asked for recommendations, Jesus promptly shared excellent suggestions for things to see and do. He even came by to say goodbye at the end of our stay, which was such a kind gesture.
If you’re visiting Barcelona, don’t hesitate to book this place. 10 stars from us!!

Perfect place for holidays and for an efficient visit of Barcelona. Very spacious  and clean apartment, fully renovated. All comfort to cook, sleep and wash. Tram and metro are at 5min walking. Lobsang is available at any moment and has a very great state of mind for renting an apartment. Highly recommended !
Very need!
Surprisingly quiet, very clean and very well situated, with excellent communication with the hosts - thank you!

I could have loved this apartment but the odor from laundry room was so bad and it permeated every room in the apartment. We had to leave all windows open in apartment at night. We could not use the washer and dryer as planned due to the foul odor. This was a huge disappointment since we were visiting Spain for almost 2 weeks. Also, one of the reasons I chose the apartment.
I shared my concerns with host and even asked for a candle to mask the odor, they could not provide a candle and offered us nothing more.
Unfortunately, this was an inconvenience and made our stay less enjoyable. We spent the days out of the apartment and had to deal with the terrible odor during the night and early mornings. This changes perspective of a luxury stay.

Highly recommend Carlos's place for any type of stay.  Two of the bedrooms have bathrooms inside the room and the other bedroom has the bathroom right outside, which also serves as the guest bathroom. The living room/dining room is very spacious that can easily sit 6-8 people in the combined space.  The apartment is surrounded by wonderful restaurants, close to the metro, and in a safe neighborhood.  Would stay here again for sure!
Good apt. All good
Muy buena estancia, muy buena ubicación, los muros son algo delgados y se escucha algo de ruido entre habitaciones, pero en general es excelente
Calidez y atención por parte de Victor, acogedor el apartamento, cerca del medio de transporte y cerca al centro histórico. Muchas gracias Victor por tu hospitalidad.

Logement au calme mais près des centres touristiques !
Appartement très bien !
Je recommande
There was very fine
Apartamento lindo e bem localizado, ótimas cafeterias por perto. Perto de tudo.  Ambiente super limpo e tranquilo.Super indico.
Eine großzügige, schlicht und geschmackvoll eingerichtete Wohnung in sehr guter Lage.

Très bel appartement dans un immeuble situé dans un endroit paisible et calme de la rue Consell de Cent. Nous avons visité la ville de Barcelone uniquement en marchant! Tous les sites intéressants à visiter sont relativement proches. Nos hôtes ont été très proactifs à répondre à nos questions. Bravo!
Nice little apartment. Great location, secure building and had all the necessities.
The Perfect apartment in Barcelone. Le localisation is amazing!

We really enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend it. Communication was excellent and Olivia met us at check in and was on hand for anything we needed during our stay. Apartment was great, very spacious and in an excellent location and we would definitely stay here again!
superbe appartement.  très bel accueil et un bon emplacement. personne serviable disponible et gentille. nous recommandons et nous reviendrons  !!!
Прекрасне місце залишитися поки перебуваєш у Барселоні! Дуже сподобалося. Дякую!
Every things was good. The host the location. The only things what i felt it need to be improved, that the wash room is very tight and its cold in the  winter

We really enjoyed our stay. Great location. The host was super responsive and helped us with transport (bus from airport) and was at the apartment waiting for us when we arrived. Apartment was spotless with great wifi. Got some good restaurant recommendations from host and intel on local lockers with a discount code. Highly recommend. fab location

Great place with everything you need, full equiped kitchen, great bed and bedroom, good position with close restaurants, bus stations, metro, etc.
Only 1 thing, the balcony is smaller than in images, and is pretty scarry if you re afraid of hights. But this is just not a big incovenience. I highly recomend, it s a great choice if you re looking for a cozy place to stay.

Antonio and Robert took great care of us. They went way above expectation to accommodate our schedule. Our stay has been wonderful. Thank you!
Great apartment, lots of natural light, great location. Will definitely come back again.

This Airbnb is conveniently located, exceptionally clean, and accessible for all. My group thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and was able to access all parts of the city. Great communication, hospitality, and overall experience with Eva & Jack!

Gran piso en una ubicación muy buena. El soporte del anfitrión muy buena, accesible en cualquier momento.  Disponibilidad de cunas para bebés y amplitud del alojamiento para poder estar un número elevado de huéspedes.  Un acierto

Ev Sagrada Familia’ya 5 dk yürüme mesafesindeydi, konumu çok iyi ve metro istasyonuna çok yakındı. Odalar kullanışlı mutfakta ihtiyaç olabilecek her şey mevcuttu. Banyo biraz ufaktı hareket etmek çok kolay değil ama ihtiyaçlarımızı gördü. Sadece cumartesi gece 2 de karşıdaki dairenin kapısında yüksek sesle bir şeyler tamir ediliyordu ve oldukça uzun sürdü. Bunun dışında her şey iyiydi tavsiye ederim.

Josefa is a very kind person who cares about her guests. When we had questiones before our arrival she answered very fast and gave us good advices on how to get to her apartment.
Her apartment is comfortable and lovely furnished. The room included a fan which is nice. It could get a little bit noisey because you can hear the neighbors but it's not that bad. The bathroom was nice and always clean.
Thanks a lot for that!

The place is one of the nicer I've ever seen in bcn I've cold ac private elevator modern and beautiful. Mr duncan was very helpful and a great person to deal with!! The location is perfect in the heart of the city not the nicest neighborhood but for me it was no problem wasthe one thing i will say was a problem was the landlord, a roomate of mine was playing her guitar at 10pm with the patio door open for about one hour nothing crazy she was just practicing and singing it was very nice. The next morning a guy who claimed to be the landlord knocked on my door and threatened to kick me and my roommates out with no refund because of noise. This is a neighborhood where theres kids running around lighting off fireworks right next to la rambla and theres noise throughout the day and night. Two weeks later we got accused of having another party which we did not we were all sleeping but got accused (theres a lot of other people living in this building) i just want to say its a awful feeling when your paying to stay somewhere and get accused and threatened to be kicked out on the street for something you did not do or that they have no proof it was us. For the amount of money i paid to be there i felt like i was walking on eggshells . The apartment is amazing and its the best spot you can have in my opinion but i felt like this needed to be said because it was not fair to me . Everything else besides this one thing was good but if you have people paying good money to stay theres a right way to treat people, again mr duncan was a saint and was so helpful and amazing but the landlord was the one problem. Other than that the trip was great and the flat amazing it had everything you could want and need
Alles ist perfekt!
Sehr angenehm. Die Lage ist wirklich top. Das Zimmer ist nicht all zu groß aber für 2-3 Leute reicht es total aus.

The apartment is comfortable, clean, airy and has everything you need. Marta is a wonderful person, always willing to solve any kind of problem. The location is excellent: there is a metro station just a few meters away. It was a great experience: I hope to come back again.

This apartment is wonderful! It was the perfect space for our family of 5 -- with everyone having their own corner to escape to after days on end of touristy things. Amenities like coffee, a computer and printer, tons of books, etc., make it a gem. It is in a great part of town, just a couple blocks from Placa de Catalunya. We'd love to have the opportunity to stay here again!

A very comfortable apartment for us to stay with 2 couples and 1 child. Having an ensuite in the main bedroom was excellent. Great storage throughout the apartment and lovely open living/dining area. Well equipped kitchen and a great district close to the metro and within an easy walking distance of Sagrada Familia. Having a lift was very handy for getting luggage upstairs! Thank you for a lovely stay.
Beautiful apartment, fabulous location, super quiet for sleeping at night.  Very clean, comfy beds.
Had a great stay. Very easy to find and well located.
Highly recommended, Manuel & Fabiano very helpful !!

Oriol's apartment was perfect for my family and I. Convenient location with a grocery store across the street and numerous restaurants and cafes just steps away. Oriol was really accessible and offered great suggestions for places to check out. Definitely would stay again!

De accomodatie was perfect gelegen
Wel 1 min puntje er was s’nachts wel een beetje lawaai van boven ons maar het was perfect prijs kwaliteit

Nice place to stay, you can find everything you need in the apartment, great balcony.  You can find clean towels and everything for a great stay, the check in was easy and fast, key was sent to my phone for entry, a lot of stores and bars close by. One thing for the guests with cars, get a small car because the parking was small otherwise we had a great stay and everything was fine for my family thanks Eva&Jack.
Very good location, easy travel from the centre of Barcelona. Lots of spaces even for families.
Lovely apartment in a very convenient location.  The little terrace off of the back is such a nice feature.  The nearby Placa de Rovira is a gem!
Consigliato

We had a lovely stay at Francesca and Davide’s place. They are warm, kind, and very welcoming hosts, always ready to help. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located for exploring Barcelona. We felt at home from the first moment and truly enjoyed our stay. Highly recommended!
Great place, value, and location
Very nice place with very nice location. And staff was also kind and helpful. Thank you 🙏😊
Schlicht aber top ausgestattet, in bester Lage. Trotz der Straße sehr ruhig.
Super cómodo
The apartment is brilliantly located and spacious. Lluis is the best host I've had using airbnb. He was extremely helpful and very welcoming.
Tks. Good stay
Loved the location and the house
Amazing apartment and perfect location in the city centre! The apartment was very big and beautiful.
The apartment reminded me of how much I love Barcelona.  Monica exudes Spanish charm.  Balcony, check! Fabulous furnishings, check. Spacious, check!!  Neighborhood bakeries, check!!!!!

Unfortunately, my group and I had several issues in our stay. The unexpected fee of 20 euros upon check-in can be an unpleasant surprise for guests, and the lack of hot water in the bath, malfunctioning air conditioner, blocked sink in the kitchen, and light turning off all the time can be significant inconveniences that detract from the overall experience of the stay.
Furthermore, it's disappointing that the host was slow to respond and did not provide adequate support in addressing these issues. Due to the issues, we've requested the cancellation of the reservation, and the amount paid due to the tourism tax in Barcelona was also not reimbursed by the host, which didn't even provided a response.
I don't recommend staying here.

La situation était idéale si vous désirez séjourner près de l’hôpital sant Pau mais le centre est accessible en métro. Les hôtes sont très réactifs sur l’application airbnb au moindre problème , étaient très accueillants et de bons conseils pour les petits restos du coin. David Bowie, leur canari égayera votre séjour.

Cannot recommend this spot enough if you are looking for a perfect spot to base out of in Barcelona! It’s in a great spot, Roberto was an amazing host who gave us great recommendations & was such a kind host meeting us when we arrived/checked out. The flat is clean, beautifully decorated, newly renovated, comfortable bed & pillows! 10/10 stay!!! We loved every minute of it!
Look no further! This is seriously the most perfect Airbnb in the heart of Barcelona!
Apartment suited our needs, but if we are back in Barcelona and finances dictate it, we would go more central.

O apartamento está muito bem localizado, há apenas 1 quarteirão de distância do metrô. Tem um mercado de frente e muitas lojas próximas. Tudo estava muito limpo e organizado. Infelizmente, não é um local tranquilo e silencioso, havia muito barulho entre os vizinhos, sendo que o vizinho de cima tem crianças que gritam e choram durante quase todo o dia.
非常舒适的居住体验。顶楼带阳台的实在在舒服了。
Muy bien

Joaquin was an excellent host.  Communication was prompt and we were able to check in early with Joaquin there to personally greet us himself.  Apartment is few blocks from the closest metro stop and you can easily walk downtown to the central train station in about 15 mins. There is a fruit market right next door that my parents loved and a few cafes just down the street.

The place is impeccably clean and has everything for your comfortable staying. The location is superb: 2 min walk to Fontana metro station or 20 min walk to the famous attractions. There are lots of nice restaurants nearby. We highly recommend to stay at Nacho’s place.

Localização ótima, perto do metro, ideal para 4 pessoas, zona calma.
Tanto a Lilya como a Tatiana, são pessoas extremamente educadas e amigáveis, sempre disponíveis e atenciosas. Durante a estadia, ficamos sem água quente, e não conseguiram resolver o problema a tempo de nos sairmos, mas tiveram isso em consideração e devolveram nos uma parte do valor de 1 noite.
Apesar dos contratempos recomendo imenso este espaço.
Tout est conforme

Excellent séjour, appartement très bien situé avec les lignes de métro en bas de l’appartement desservant les lieux touristiques. Le seul défaut de l’appartement est l’absence de clim mais c’est plutôt bien compensé par les nombreux ventilateurs à disposition. Marta est très réactive et prend soin de ses hôtes. Je recommande !

Heel mooi en ruim appartement.
Appartement ligt centraal, metrostation en busstation zitten om de hoek.
Thank u so much, very nice apartment, best location ever!
You have been great - thanks Monica and the apartment was perfect for our family.  Barcelona is a great city we only wish we had longer 😀

The apartment is at very good location, 10 min from Ramblas and 2 minutes from Aerobus station if you're arriving from the airport. Metro station is also very near, 2 minutes away. We went to see Barcelona game at Estadio Montjuic by foot (30 min walk). The apartment has two bedrooms and two bathrooms and it was spaceous enough for five of us. The kitchen is well equiped. The only thing that was missing was that there were 3 sets of towels waiting for us and there was five of us, but we managed and I'm sure the owner would provide more if we asked (it was a short stay so we didn't want to bother).  Check-in is very simple, especially if you're arriving late like we did. It's a great place to stay for your Barcelona visit.

We had amazing stay at Anna-Ralph’s place. It was amazingly fresh and clean, perfect location for what we wanted and you can walk to the port in around 20ish minutes or the Olympic stadium in around 15. It had everything you needed for a great city break and it felt like home away from home.  We enjoyed every minute of our stay and there were lots of bars and restaurants very close by in the local square and many supermarkets/pharmacies within a few minute walk. Can’t recommend  it enough.

Ricard's apartment is fantastic.  It is roomy and super clean and has everything that you could ever need for your visit to Barcelona.  Ricard  was easy to get in touch with before and during our stay when we needed to make some changes and and were running a little later than expected.  The neighbourhood is close to everything but away from the tourist filled downtown area.  There are also some amazing restaurants and bars nearby so while it is quite at the apartment you only have to walk a block to experience some great food and culture.  Highly recommended!!!
The apartment was brand new, well located, clean, and the reception smooth and courteous.
Vladimir y su esposa fueron las personas que nos recibieron, desde el inicio fueron muy atentos y serviciales. El piso super limpio, amplio y muy acogedor. Volvería nuevamente.

El sitio es lindo aunque pequeño, pero no resta comodidad. Hay disponibilidad para lavar ropa y utilizar la cocina. Johanna es muy amable y siempre está pendiente para ayudar. La zona es por el Clot, hay muchos restaurantes y bares. Muy cerca del metro clot y Camp del arpa, lo que da acceso rápido al centro, aereopuerto y estación sants sin problema. Recomiendo ampliamente

Carles’s apartment was perfect for our short stay in Barcelona! It is in a beautiful building in a nice and very walkable neighborhood. We typically look for places with 2-3 bedrooms because our kids out light sleepers, and we want to be able to make coffee in the morning without waking them up. But because the rhythm of life is later in Spain (we ate dinner “early” there, usually arriving at a restaurant around 7:30 to 8 and finishing between 9 and 10 pm), it worked out just fine with our kids sleeping on a similar schedule to us while there. Our boys loved the loft, and we appreciated the air conditioning to cool off during siesta, the beautiful patio, the style/architecture, and the location. Carles was proactive and very helpful in his communication. Also of note: we turned in our rental car thinking that it would be very difficult parking in Barca; however, we were surprised at how easy it would have been to park. That said, we had no need for the car. Thank you Carles!
位置很好，能步行去教堂景點，住處對面有超市，附近步行幾分鐘也有出色的食肆，非常方便。

Don't hesitate, book this stay! The home was clean, private, and walkable to so many parts of the city. Days before arriving, Anna ensured we had check in instructions and even arranged for a driver to pick us up from the airport. She supplied us with the phone number of her local contact who met us to give us the keys and ensure we got into the apartment. She was very responsive during our stay. Anna's home was thoroughly cleaned before our arrival. The balcony was lovely and the apartment was spacious for the two of us. There was a functional elevator and being on the top floor, the apartment was quiet at night.
דירה חמודה.  קצת פחות מהתמונות אבל בהחלט מספקת. מנהלי הנכס מסייעים בכל דבר. אזור מעט מרוחק מהמרכז אבל נגיש עם תחבורה ציבורית
It was a great stay, I like the decoration of the apartment, and the location is really good
Clean rooms, friendly staff and great location for a short trip to Barcelona.
Todo perfecto y cerca del Montjuic, por lo que fue ideal para ir y volver a pie del concierto.

Gut gelegene Wohnung in Barcelona, das Viertel ist total angenehm zum schlendern. Man ist mittendrin und die Wohnung ist sehr ruhig und neu. Viele Bars und Tapas in Laufnähe. Kann die Unterkunft nur weiterempfehlen. Der  Kontakt mit den Jungs war super nett - sehr unkompliziert. Würden wieder kommen!

Très bon séjour en avril dans l'appartement d'Encarnacion. L'appartement correspondait bien à la description, il venait en plus d'être repeint à neuf! il est bien situé car à 5 minutes du métro d'Horta qui dessert ensuite tout le centre ville de Barcelone. Idéal pour une grande famille (nous étions 8), même s'il y a un peu d'embouteillage pour la salle de bains le matin! Le quartier est calme et vivant à la fois (café, boulangerie, petites boutiques... à quelques pas de l'appartement). C'est Sergio, le fils d'Encarnacion, qui nous a chaleureusement accueillis et a pris le temps de nous indiquer quelques adresses intéressantes et lignes de métro à prendre. Bon séjour aux futurs voyageurs!
Kommer gärna tillbaka!
The location was great and the apartment was big enough for us three. Thank you for having us!

Es war alles super! Die Lage war sehr gut, schnelle Rückmeldung kam von Laura. Nur in der Küche haben ein paar Dinge wie Pfanne, zu wenig Topfe gefehlt. Sonst war alles sehr schön!!!
Vielen Dank Laura!
VG
Erica

Cette appartement nous a déçu… Tout d’abord l’état général de l’appartement est différent de celui des photos : murs sales, mobiliers abimés…
Mais le plus dérangeant est l’isolation. Quand le voisin rentre chez lui on a l’impression de l’entendre rentrer dans l’appartement. Pareil pour les bruits venant de la rue.
De plus, les personnes qui le loue ne sont pas arrangeante puisque nous avons réservé pour 2 nuits et dès notre arrivé nous avons voulu annuler la location. Pour couper la poire en deux nous avons accepté de payer la 1ere nuit même si nous restons pas et non aucune réponse de leur part sur ce sujet..
lugar lindísimo para pasar tus días en Barcelona, centrico y muy disfrutable para ti y tu familia. recomendaciones locales muy buenas, ninguna queja!
Great stay
Très bon emplacement, déco originale, très pratique !
Susa very kind and friendly! The apartment is very comfortable! Everything was super!
Great place! Couldn't have asked for anything better. Check in was easy and the place is super secure and located in a great area. Would definitely stay here again!
Very nice, clean and well located!

lovely flat, clean and all the things we needed.
A little confusion over the amount of beds (2 or 3) but apart from that it was all good
All was good. Close to the beach, clean and cosy apartment. A lot of shops and restaurants in this area.
This apartment is incredible! So beautifully designed, great location.  Wish I could have stayed longer!
Very pleasant stay and right on the beach and walkable to plenty of places

The apartment is great and is just like the photos. Beds were clean and comfortable. The bathroom was small but adorable. Plenty of hot water for showers for the three of us. The location was central to everything that we were interested in seeing and is located on a small neighborhood plaza where you could sit outside and have a beer from the local places on the plaza.
Diego was a great host and very patient with our chaotic travel issues (missed flights, etc.)! He was easily reached and provided great local tips.
If you're headed to Barcelona, this is where you want to stay.
Thank you Diego!!

Good value for the location as it was super Central.
Perfect for a big bunch of boys, good for getting your head down and wash and out!
Very spacious and good living area. Free WiFi also which was a plus and nice soft bedding and towels.
Communication was good from Sam and check in was very easy!
Only down side the bathrooms are a bit tired and the showers leaked a bit from the hoses.
Also have very heavy rain one day and the back (area of shower room) sent water in through the door. Had to dry up with towels.
Overall great location 👍 and ok value for the money between 11 lads
Le logement était conforme, très fonctionnel, et l’hôte répond rapidement.

It’s a nice little apartment, on the 3rd floor, accessible by staircase or small elevator(not ideal for a stroller).It’s very close to the Metro station and some major sightseeing and the beach. Gabrielle is a very friendly and helpful host. Thank you

We stayed at Romina's apartment for 3 days, and absolutely loved it! Romina was the perfect host - she was incredibly helpful, made sure we were comfortable, and took care of any questions we had. Her apartment is perfectly located, and looks just like the pictures - if not better. I would absolutely stay at her apartment again!

We had a great time staying at Phil and Fiona's apartment. Phil welcomed us and he was very friendly and, well, welcoming! They also made sure we knew we could reach out to them with any questions and responded promptly when we did. The apartment definitely has a great location, and we loved the neighborhood as well. If you are a runner like me, you can run from the apartment to the port and the beach. The apartment also has a great inside view, and plenty of natural night. We didn't cook, but it seemed to have everything you would need to cook if you wanted to do so. We had dinner twice at Rene, one of the places Phil recommended, because the food was great and everybody was super friendly, so we definitely recommend that as well. We had a great time in Barcelona, and having a nice place to come back "home" to made it even better.
Really loved our stay here, would definitely recommend

Franziska’s Place is in a very quiet neighborhood. There is a convenient store next to it and another one across the street. The Train Station is on the corner which makes it easy to move around. The apartment has 2 bathrooms one full bathroom and 1/2 bathroom which makes it perfect for our family of 5. The apartment is better than the pictures the beach is in a walkable distance.

Das Apartment entspricht der Beschreibung und Vincent war jederzeit für alles erreichbar.
Gleich nebenan ist ein kleiner Bar, wo man morgens eine Kleinigkeit zu essen und einen leckeren Café con leche bekommt. Ein bisschen weiter ist ein Bäckerei, auch Gott für ein kleines Frühstück.
Der Blick vom Balkon ist perfekt!

Location, location! The apartment is in a fantastic neighbourhood - away from the tourist crowds but plenty of great places to eat and shop, and the amazing Sant Antoni market right across the road. Line 2 Metro station is super close, and Line 3 not far either. We found it an ideal place to come and go from anywhere we wanted to visit. We really enjoyed sitting out on the roof terrance and the lounge area is nice too - this was great as I injured myself while we were in Barcelona, so it was nice to just be able to enjoy the space resting at the apartment for a while. The wifi and hot water were great. On the negative side we did struggle with the beds. They are both very small, and one has bad roll-together. We swapped with our daughter on the second night and that was slightly better. Also make sure you pick up any food immediately because as SOON as you turn your back the ants will be onto it! We didn't get to meet or talk much with Mires, though others have said she is lovely and helpful. But otherwise everything was good - I'd definitely recommend it, would stay again.

Perfect location and perfect host. He made wonderful suggestion on where to eat and where to go. The condo has everything you need in it and nicely decorated without clutter.  We got very lucky to find such a gem.
Photos makes you think it's a little bit more spacier, also the place is really good on the map but you will need to take the metro to go to the mainnattractions. Overall impression is okay 👍
Die Wohnung ist mit dem nötigsten möbliert. Im großen und ganzen sauber. Sie liegt sehr zentral und ruhig, ohne Verkehr vor der Haustür :)

I loved this spot! It was spacious and functional enough that we could unpack and settle in, which we loved. It’s in an awesome location in the Poble Sec neighborhood, with lots of markets, bars and cafes nearby. It was also close to transit, which meant most of Barcelona was at our fingertips in 20 min. Nicolas was a great host. We especially appreciated how he helped us find a gym nearby! I highly recommend staying here.
Excelente AirBnb. Muy bien ubicado. El lugar es muy turístico. Hay muchos bares y restaurantes cerca. El host muy amable.
Très confortable et propre. Emplacement idéal avec de bons restos tout près
The apartment was as described and was spacious and clean. It was located in a good location and close links to public transport.
It was beautiful apartment and the view from the apartment was stunning. The host was responsive and friendly helped with any requests made

It was very, very clean and much quieter than we were expecting, considering it´s right next to a tourist hot-spot. The walls are thicker than average too, so you don´t really hear other people much. We had no issue at all going to sleep! The pillows were very comfortable too.
The loo was always free too and also cleaned.
They offered to clean our room daily too.
I´d recommend staying here!

For couples looking for a quiet, private and cozy place, this is a good apartment with a nice terrace and easy access to the L5 metro. We enjoyed being away from the tourists yet close via an easy walk to La Sagrada Familia and the Hospital Sant Pau - a hidden gem to visit!
The neighborhood is geared toward locals. With a short walk you can find any type of place to eat, get groceries, and hop on the metro. I think it's best suited for visitors who want privacy and are comfortable traveling to get to the more populated destinations.
The home itself had good wifi, A/C, and a comfortable bed. The terrace was a highlight and we spent many evenings enjoying meals and drinks on a quiet rooftop. The interior of the home is at ground level, and there is good light, but no view to the outside.
Guests staying more than a few days should bring their own shampoo, soap and kitchen needs; only the most basic amenities were provided. It felt overpriced for what we received - but it is summer.

El lugar estuvo excelente, El check in sin problemas y el lugar donde esta ubicado tiene buena ubicación para moverte fácil ya sea caminando o por servicio de transporte local, sin problema regresaría, gracias Aitor
Этот аппартамент нам очень понравился. Было чисто и комфортно. Достопримечательности в пешей доступности. Рекомендую!
房东很好，同意我们提前入住了，并且帮我们把很重的箱子提到房间，电梯很快应该可以使用了，公寓楼下有周日不关门的超市，周边公交地铁都很方便

Decent place for a family or group of 3-5. Amenities are great. Kitchen well stocked , this apartment will fit you if you plan to cook or make something small for breakfast . We didn’t !! We were on the go The Whole 3 nights we were there .
A little far if you want to be in downtown or in center of action . Taxi is necessary. Overall , very pleasant experience for us !
Lovely little place to stay in Barcelona. Had everything we needed and in a good location
Sonia’s place is conveniently located near great tapas bars, Montjuic and the Gothic Quarter. The apartment was clean and well-equipped. Absolutely recommend!

The area is full of drugs. The apartment is located in a very old dilapidated building. No elevator made it very difficult getting up to the apartment with our luggage. The bedroom with the bunkbeds has thin curtains and a peeping tom was caught looking in from across the alley at us while we were naked and preparing for bed. He seemed very comfortable as if he has done this before. Late night prostitution was happening right on our street corner  and the building is located with cannabis dispensaries on both sides right next door. Otherwise the neighborhood is vibrant close to transportation, restaurants and sightseeing. The apartment was large and clean but I do believe we were being watched by camera in the living room. I would not stay there again. Plaster dust falls from the ceiling onto the upper bunk bed so we couldn’t sleep in that bed.
Excelente lugar y ubicación. Recomendado!!!

Notre séjour chez Virginia s’est extrêmement bien passé. L’appartement est très confortable et dispose surtout d’un emplacement incroyable. Super accessible, vous pouvez vous rendre dans les différents sites d’intérêt très facilement grâce aux nombreuses options de transport à proximité. Au delà de cela le quartier lui même regorge d’excellentes adresses. Virginia a enfin été une hôte prévenante, accueillante et gentille. Elle a été très flexible quant aux horaires de départ ce qui a rendu notre fin de séjour extrêmement facile. Merci encore de nous avoir si gentiment accueillis. Je recommande à 100% cette location,

During our stay we had a great time. The apartment is in a perfect location, metro is 3 minutes walking and you can get to the Rambla in about 10 minutes. The apartment has everything you need, a diswasher, washing machine, coffee machine, all the stuff you need in a kitchen. Having a small balcony was also very nice. The host was very kind and left us a note with information such as where the metrostation is. I would highly recommend this place!
Will definitely stay here again. Great location, great host.
Fantastic location, very helpful host, walking distance to many great spots. Highly recommend staying here.

Ana & Rafa were really helpful, gave really clear instruction on how to get there, super responsive to any questions we had. Place was super clean, good location. We were staying a short while in Barcelona so wanted easy and quick access to and from the airport and this accommodated for it. Lots to do in the area and close to transport. Recommend for your next stay in Barcelona.
Super Erlebniss
Consigliatissimo.

We had a wonderful stay at Angeles’ place! He was very descriptive with the check in process and made it very easy. The apartment was as described with all the amenities listed and more! Close to public transport, supermarkets and cafes. Felt very luxurious! The balcony was the best feature of the apartment with stunning views and a place to relax. If we ever visit Barcelona again we know where to stay! Thank you!
We had a great stay in Pau's apartment. It's only a couple of metro stations away from city centre but very quiet. It's also very spacious and clean. Thank you!
Can’t recommend enough. Nothing like living next door to one of the wonders of the world. Everything walkable, so many great restaurants, friendly and hopeful host. Would come back!

Super hôte, Juan est très agréable, l'appartement est très propre ainsi que l'accès à un petit jardin au centre de la ville. L'appartement est directement dans une zone avec plein de restaurant et un accès rapide à la Rambla, le tout au calme.
Perfect stay. Wonderful host, vibrant area and so easy to get everywhere we wanted to go. And we loved the apartment. Thank you!
Really clean room, communication was excellent, location was awesome too, great neighbourhood! We really enjoyed our stay!

Perfect place to stay in Barcelona I think. Very nice access from the international airport by bus, easy access to the central area by metro, near from Poble Sec where there are many nice pintxos bars. The room, bath room, kitchen is very clean and cosy. Monica's response is very quick and accurate. I was really satisfied to stay here!
Un alojamiento bien ubicado, cerca de todo y una excelente comunicación con el anfitrión!!
nice place, nice location, well equipped

Everything was perfect!! I fully recommend this! Big bed, everything clean, not noisy because the room has good location in flat. Great location in center.
Just perfect
Thank you!!

The location and apartment itself were great. Safe neighborhood, lot of cafes & bars nearby. Very nice apartment, just as advertised, very nicely prepared & clean with all the necessary amenities, with a nice welcome bottle of cava too!
We just had a little issue with the water heater in one of the bathrooms, as it ran out of hot water very quickly. We did report this, and someone quickly came to check the very next day, but unfortunately it continued to happen even after that, so we just had to work around it. Also the master key almost didn’t work when we first checked in (but they promised they would toss that particular key away after that happened).
I still recommend this place to stay in Barcelona despite these minor issues, especially since they are quite easy to fix, now that the owners are aware.
This apartment was lovely and clean, beautifully presented and in a fantastic location. Our host was very responsive and we truly enjoyed our time here

The apartment is fantastic. Location is great. The subway station is near. Many attractions can be reached in 20mins which is really convenient and time-saving. The interior is good. The apartment is clean and tidy. The host is really thoughtful and  provide things we need. We checked in at a really late time but Lydia still waited for us and provided all the useful instruction with patience. The response is always quick. The apartment has sufficient facilities make life easier, like washing machine and dish washer. We really enjoy the time staying in this apartment and Barcelona. Will definitely choose it again when next visit.

Très très beau logement, très bien situé (station de mettre à quelques mètres)
Un accueil formidable !
L’apprtement est très propre, conforme aux photos.
Je garde ce logement en favoris pour sûrement y retourner !
Vous pouvez y aller les yeux fermés !

This apartment is so lovely! Really nice, non touristy neighborhood, with lots of restaurants within walking distance and very close to the metro. The apt itself is very quiet and comfortable. I hope to come back!

Everything was as listed and pictured.
It was a perfect place to stay!
Great location. Close to everything and a supermarket across the street
房间宽大，舒适，洗衣方便

Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer sehr guten Lage.
Die Wohnung war jedoch sehr dreckig und die Matratze war geprägt von undefinierbaren Flecken.
Das Bad war leider so gestaltet, dass nach einem Duschgang der Boden überschwemmt war.

Świetnie położone mieszkanie. Czyste i wygodne. w pełni wyposażone. Lokalizacja idealna. W zasięgu spaceru większość atrakcji. Dla tych co nie lubią spacerować co najmniej trzy stacje metra do 5 minut piechota. W mieszkaniu i okolicy można poczuć lokalny klimat. Hala targowa, bary i kawiarnie dookoła. Polecam z przekonaniem a sama pewnie wrócę wracając do Barcelony.
Everything was perfect
Great stay!

Excellent stay at the apartment! Sabrina was extremely communicative and responsive throughout! The apartment is a stone throw away from many good tapas restaurants and easy to get to from the airport.

Die Wohnung war sauber und gepflegt. Wir hatten eine gute Zeit.
Jedoch hatten wir nur 3 Rollen Toilettenpapier zur Verfügung für eine ganze Woche. Wir haben dies dann noch selber in einem Supermarkt eingekauft.
Als wir nach neuen Badetüchern gefragt haben, hätten wir pro Set (Badetuch + Handtuch ) 10 EUR bezahlen müssen. Wir haben sie dann einfach selber 1 Mal gewaschen.
Es wäre gut gewesen, hätte es im Badezimmer auch ein Tuch für die Hände gehabt.
In der Küche hat uns Öl + Salz gefehlt. Wir hätten es auch geschätzt, wenn ein Abtrocknungstuch für das Geschirr vorhanden gewesen wäre.
Sonst war alles in Ordnung. Vielen Dank für alles, sie waren immer gut erreichbar, dies hat einen guten Eindruck hinterlassen.

Die Unterkunft ist für 5 Personen ausgeschrieben, realistisch aber höchstens für 3 geeignet. Das Sofa ist extrem hart, das Bett (1,40 m) zu klein für zwei Personen und es gibt nur eine Dusche, die kaum warmes Wasser liefert und undicht ist. Nach jeder Dusche war der Boden nass. Es gibt keine Schlüsselbox, die Hosts wohnen weit weg. Als wir ein Handy vergessen hatten, dauerte es fast drei Stunden, bis jemand kam um die Wohnung zu öffnen, unsere Freundin verpasste deshalb ihren Flug. Wir mussten Fotos unserer Ausweise schicken und 75 € Touristensteuer bar ohne Rechnung zahlen, das wirkt nicht seriös. Auch der Kontakt war unfreundlich, zusätzlich sollte 30 € für ein spätes Check-in verlangt werden, was so nicht in den Richtlinien stand. Bei Ankunft gab es kein versprochenes Wasser, der „24 h-Kiosk“ war geschlossen (kamen Mitternacht an). Wohnung hell, Lage okay, aber laut und nachts unsicher (besonders als Frau). Insgesamt enttäuschend und nicht empfehlenswert.

In general, we were quite disappointed with this apartment. In our opinion it is totally misrepresented in the pictures and description and way overpriced for what you actually get.  The positives were that it was big, the location is very convenient, the building itself is very charming and the living room space is quite cozy. On the negative side, it was NOT an apartment that is flooded with light. In fact, we ended up calling it the Bunker, as only the living room faces the street. All other rooms face light tunnels towards the back where you basically cannot open the blinds, because the neighbors are right in front of your window and can see in. So all other rooms are in the dark constantly. It also does not appear to be recently renovated, or they only renovated the living room, as overall the apartment seems to be on its last leg in many aspects. The bathrooms are very old and run down. The bathroom bordering onto the master bedroom smelled of sewage the whole time and the door frame was rotting for about 10 inches up from the floor (I think from previous flooding of the bathroom). The grouting between the tiles is dark from being old. And worst of all, there were cockroaches in the bathroom. If you leave the fan on all the time they don`t seem to come in, so I figured they came from the roof. Until I figured that out, I killed at least 5 a day.  The blow dryer, toaster, nespresso machine, blinds, and toilet flushers are on their last leg - kept breaking or cutting out and turning back on. The kitchen is minimally equipped. For such a large apartment, we had exactly 4 butter knives and ended up washing everything by hand over our 8 day stay, as it wasn´t enough to fill up a dishwasher and we needed to use the knives for breakfast again the next day. In addition, we basically did not get any sleep the first half of our stay, as the walls seem to be very thin and the building noisy. We realize, our stay was the time over New Years, which is fine. There was an all night party two floors below on New Years, which was ok. But all the other days, the apartment next to the master bedroom seems to have its living room right there, and there was a group of young guys partying every night all night. We escaped to the bedroom in the front, but there you get woken up from the loud clanking of the elevator, when everyone returns after corona shutdown of the bars at 1 am. So, if you are a family with kids, like us, who do not follow partying sleeping hours, the apartment is not ideal. I contacted the agency several times and they always answered right away with a very apologetic e-mail and then we had the feeling nothing happened. We actually have the suspicion that they have bots answering the mails. Overall, for that price, we would not recommend this apartment and to be honest, felt quite cheated  by the description.

The place was absolutely perfect! We were just steps away from the Gothic Quarter, making it easy to explore the city on foot, and taxis were always simple to catch when needed. Cool place in a great location, walkable to most places. Honestly not much more you can ask for. But clearly, this apartment is very good as I am nit picking now.

Great value for money. The rooms were clean and we had an amazing view from our window. The pool on the 6th floor wasn’t large and deep enough but it could be managed.
Also, the hotel is well located which makes it easy for accessibility.
I will definitely be coming around again next time I visit Barcelona
Would definitely recommend. Enjoyed being able to walk almost everywhere. Joan is truly a super host and lived up to all the comments we read before our trip.

The hosts were very friendly and communicated well. The apartment is clean, has all the amenities you need, the little balconies are especially great. Lluis and his place were very lovely. Lluis had helpful tips on local tapas restaurants to try. Really great location and beautiful rooftop patio.

Logement bien placé et accessible par le transport public.
Bon rapport qualité prix.
Merci Oriol
Хубав, чист апартамент със прекрасна локация. Любезен и отзивчив домакин.

Beautiful house as photos, my friend and I stayed 3nights at Eva’s. She is very friendly and helpful, we have got many informations from Eva before exploring Barcelona City. The place is located right next to train station and airport bus station (3mins by walk) too, shopping mall, supermarket and restaurants are close to the house. I strongly recommend Eva’s house to future visitors. Hope everyone do not missed out this beautiful house!!😊
여행오시는 한국분들 에게도 강추!!
수건 헤어드라이어 작은 냉장고 까지 구비 되어있어서 너무 편했구요. 작은 발코니가 있어서 냄새걱정없이 친구랑 컵라면, 컵밥도 먹었네요. 👍
Excelente localização. Espaço limpo. Serviço check in impecável.

We stayed for a month in the apartment and it was fantastic. Alex met us at the entrance, helped with our luggage and gave a nice tour of the apartment.
The location was ideal. Being right in the Gothic Quarter meant that there were shops, restaurants, grocery stores and everything we needed close by.
The apartment was a great setup for us. We had a visitor stay for a few days and the separation of the bedrooms and the 2 full bathrooms worked out great and gave everyone some privacy.
The only thing to consider is that the apartment is on the 3rd floor (50 steps up) so if you have any mobility issues it might be tough.
Overall, I’d highly recommend the apartment and Alejandro!
Locatie buna aproape de obiective.Raportul pret calitate corect.
很舒服的一次旅程

I had a great stay at this Airbnb in Barcelona with my family. The location was great—very convenient for getting around and exploring the city. The apartment was well-equipped with all the amenities we needed, which made our stay comfortable and stress-free.
Check-in and check-out were both smooth and easy, and communication throughout the stay was clear and efficient. Jefferson, who managed our reservation, was very helpful and responsive.
Overall, it was a very positive experience and I would definitely recommend this place to others, especially for families visiting Barcelona.
地理位置优越 房间也很干净舒适
The apartment has everything, the location is great and the host is great also, had a late check out, effectively adding half a day to our stay in bcn, great guy.
Good location, nice simple place and the air conditioning was great!
Die lage war super und auch die Wohnhng an sich! Schnelle und gute kommunikation und sehr hilfreiche gastgeber :)

Fantastic place to stay in Barcelona.  Great neighbourhood. Marta and Emmaneules place was a perfect place to base ourselves from and after a big day of walking, lovely to come home to and rest. Clean, quiet,  comfy and great stay.
후안은 매우 친절했습니다. 숙소의 공간도 넓고, 청결했습니다. 그러나 오래된 주택이라 그런지 물을 사용할 때 들리는 소음이 너무 커서 불편했습니다..ㅠㅠ 1인이라면 상관 없겠지만 2인부터는 좀 불편할 수 있습니다.  뀨리고 쓕쇼애 댬봬냄섀 나니까 챰고햐쎄오.
Great communication and easy check in! The location is fantastic if you want to be close to Sagrada. View from balcony is all you can ask for.
Angel was an outstanding host- answered all our questions. We stayed at his flat for about 3 months- Loved the location the size about 100 sm

Really beautiful apartment and very well set up. Immaculate and very cozy.
A great space close to restaurants and some great bakeries.
They were very responsive and helpful with check in/out and assisted us booking our taxi to airport.
Highly recommend and would absolutely stay here again.

Hemos estado un par de días y ha sido perfecto! El piso es exacto a lo que se ve en las fotos, amplio y muy bonito. Manel es un anfitrión genial, muy amable desde el principio, nos ha aconsejado y atendido perfectamente!! Lo recomiendo sin dudar
Muito bem localizado e aconchegante, ficamos em 3 pessoas sem nenhum problema.
Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt. Die Wohnung war gross, sauber und hatte eine super Ausstattung.
房间设施很好 地段也很优越 只是没有拉帘床位私密性稍差
We had a pleasant stay in a beautiful part of Barcelona. The host was very polite and we would gladly come gain.

This is the perfect place to stay for a group. It was so comfortable with lots of natural lighting. The roof top is a brilliant addition to the place.
It is in a perfect location and check in and check out was so easy.
I would recommend this to anyone coming to Barcelona.

The apartment in itself is perfectly fine for 2 people who can share 1 bedroom. There is no second bedroom. The second supposed bedroom isn’t a bedroom - it’s a very tiny loft no more than 10 feet high which you have to climb a steep ladder to access and then crawl onto the bed. So basically my brother didn’t have a room and had to sleep on the sofa. Also the one bedroom that is across from the living area has no privacy as it just has a glass window as a wall so anyone in the living/dining area can see into the bedroom area. To top everything off Ana told us after we checked in that she was going to charge us extra towards some city tax.
L'appartamento è molto accogliente e la posizione è ottima. Metropolitana a due passi.

We spent amazing time in Barselona, and one of the reasons is great Rosa's apartment. It is 5 min walk from metro and the same to the beach! The appartment is very spacious, clean and quiet. In the kitchen you can find any gudget you need for cooking. There are a lot of cafes and bakeries right near the apartment, so you can have fresh cakes and coffee for the breakfast.Rosa is very nice person. She gave us all the maps of the city. When we checked out, accidentally we left all our documents and passports in the apartment and Rosa was very polite to call us just in 15 minuts so we came back to get it.
So if you are looking for a place to stay in Barselona near the beach - I think it is the best one!!!
Die Lage der Wohnung ist traumhaft.
Todo fue perfecto!
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour en famille. Accueilli par Andreu très serviable. On a profité du parking très pratique. L’appartement à la clim et un joli bacon. Nous recommandons vivement

Great value in a location close to public transit and good restaurants. If you are lucky enough to stay during the Festa Major de Gracia, Javier's place offers the perfect balcony view of all the festivities - even a human tower!
Appartement bien situé et propre . Équipement et décoration basique . Accueil parfait .

While it is a bit of a walk from the Gothic Quarter and beaches, it is well situated to visit La Sagrada Familia, and there are two grocery stores within a block, and plenty of excellent dining choices nearby.  We had a group of seven and cooking for the crew was a bit challenging - limited space, limited cookware (no large skillet), no basics (like oil, salt, etc), not even a scrubby sponge for cleaning up. No laundry soap or shampoo. This was our 8th Airbnb on the trip, so we were well stocked by then, but still a bit unexpected. Otherwise, a great experience.

La ubicación está súper bien, queda a 15 min caminando la sagrada familia y el metro a 10 min. Buena comunicación.
Lo único que no nos gustó fue que éramos 3 y el sofá cama no lo pudimos acondicionar solas y como es self check in no hubo nadie que nos apoyará.
Good apartment… but the best is the strategic position near everything and easy to find

El apartamento es confortable, tal como se ve en las fotos. Somos una familia con dos hijos y hemos tenido una estadía confortable y cómoda. La zona está cerca de los puntos de interés turístico, accesible por Metro que tiene una estación en la esquina del apartamento. Recomiendo que se alojen en este apartamento. Todo ha estado muy bien.
Middle of everything but also quiet at night which made it easy to sleep!
Benjamin et Josep ont été très professionnels avec moi et très accueillants. Le logement était top :) merci pour tout. Je recommande !

An excellent agent for the flat and a pleasure to deal with throughout the process. Lucia was highly responsive, very cooperative, and always willing to help whenever needed. Her friendly attitude and professionalism made the entire experience smooth and reassuring.

Todo muy bien y fácil, se nota que la casa fue renovada hace poco.
Lo más importante y que más eché de menos fue tener wifi. Quitando eso, tanto la experiencia de checkin-checkout fue perfecta y el apartamento está bien situado.
Gracias!

Pablo’s apartment is absolutely incredible. It is well located next to the city centre with lots of shops and restaurants nearby. The apartment was very well equipped with everything you need for a long or short term stay. Heavily recommend for anyone looking to explore Barcelona.
Sitio perfecto !

Merveilleusement bien situé, c'est le gros point fort de cet appartement, tout est faisable à pied et dans un quartier sympathique. Chambre vraiment belle avec cette hauteur sous plafond et ces moulures, il ya même un petit balcon.

Julia est réactive et disponible. Je recommande +++
Gutes Apartment in ruhiger Lage.

Very nice couple and a great location and space.
Casa bellissima e quartiere pure. Carles sempre disponibile e gentile.
Nos encanto el lugar super acogedor perfecta ubicacion el estilo de lugar muy original espacioso y con todo lo necesario

Fantastic apartment in the perfect location, in the gothic area but also close to the beach, comfortable beds providing a perfect nights sleep. The host offered invaluable hints and tips that made our stay, would 100% stay again.

Great location and everything you need for a long weekend. Unfortunately dirty glasses and marks on the floor.
Check in was good but PLEASE read the detail. There is city tax of around €40 (ok), and then a check in fee, which is mentioned at the very bottom of the description , but which is left vague (needs to be rewritten to be more clear) as to what constitutes a late check in and therefore incurs a charge. It turns out Saturday 4pm counts as late and costs €30. So it was an extra €70 on arrival - be aware if travelling on a budget.
The girl who checked us in was lovely and helpful so no criticism there.

Apartment was very nice and clean but the host wasn’t the best. First of all he only provided 3 rolls of toilet paper for 4 nights and 4 people, so I reached out to him and asked for more toilet paper. He told us no, and we ended up having to buy some from the store! I’ve never had this experience before. Second, we used the washing machine and our clothes got stuck in the washing machine as the door wouldn’t open. We had to try super hard to get him to send someone to come fix it, as our flight was approaching asap. Instead of sending a professional, he simply sent his friend, who could not fix the machine. I then reached out to the host to ask how he’s going to ship our clothes to us whenever a professional comes and opens the door and he said we would have to figure it out and cover the cost of shipping even though the problem was with his machine washing being broken and him not sending in a professional in time.
Alles Perfekt 🤩 Sehr empfehlenswert 👍 Wir kommen gerne wieder 😊
清理卫生的小哥虽然不懂英语，但是他很礼貌地为我们翻译成英语，再和我们交流，有心了！房东在我们入住前一直在为我们和下位房客安排事宜，友好又热情！卧室的窗开不了，或者是我们不会开，但是这无伤大雅，床很软；如果入住的人很多的话，要记得调热水器哦！地理位置也很棒！总之是一次快乐的入住☺️See u again !

This place was amazing! The host is so friendly, responds in a timely manner, answered any questions we had, and gave us restaurant recommendations! His clear instructions made check in and check out was so easy. The location was a walkable distance to so many things, and the apartment itself was in great condition. Very spacious and comfortable. Overall I highly recommend!

The apartment was really nice: clean, spacious, with the appliances described, etc
The lockers in the front desk are very helpful, specially in case of arriving/leaving before/after check in/out.
It’s is really close to the Sagrada Família, which also is a metro station connecting 2 lines).

We had a family of 4 and all loved it. We got the most out of our Barcelona stay including the opportunity to enjoy a local neighborhood. Sofia and family have a beautiful, clean home and were very attentive to us during our stay. Sofia personally welcomed us when we arrived and shared all the local spots we’d need. We will visit again.

Sehr schöne Altbauwohnung mit viel Platz um sich wohlfühlen, entspannte Atmosphäre mitten in Barcelona, superfreundliche, hilfsbereite, nette Mitarbeiter:innen, unkomplizierte Kommunikation, Storage-Room um die Ecke im Büro, tolle Location, gegenüber mittelgroßer Supermarkt, toller Bäcker einen Block weiter, Markthalle 5 min. entfernt, Fahrstuhl, Safe
super Location um BCN zu entdecken, wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt
We had a great stay, the location was quite central and had a good metro connection so we could easily explore all of Barcelona.

After receiving a cancellation of another appartement in Poblenou just a few hours before leaving to Spain, we were so lucky to find this lovely lugaris appartement close to the beach. Excellent logement. À recommander à 100%.

Très propre. Tout l’équipement nécessaire, avec des petits plus comme sel, poivre, huile, café et thé.

Possibilité de laisser gratuitement ses bagages dans des casiers fermés

L'appartement de Miguel et Rosa a été parfait pour cette semaine de découverte de Barcelone: Propre, calme, métro à proximité, mais possibilité de visiter à pieds.
Rosa et Miguel sont particulièrement accueillants: Nous avons apprécié les conseils, le vin, les fruits, les produits de première nécessité mis à disposition. Miguel nous a même très gentiment raccompagnés à la gare dimanche matin.
L'ensemble a dépassé le niveau de prestation d'un simple airbnb.
Nous recommandons!

Halyna is an amazing host, kind and responsive, and the place is exactly as described.
Super neighborhood!!  The apartment was beautiful and clean! Spacious for a family of five! I highly recommend this apartment!!
We enjoy our stay at Alejandro's place very much. The apartment has AC and it is very well connected to the city and all attractions. Thanks for everything!
Очень хорошая квартира!

We loved our stay! Check-in was well organised and communication was seamless. We loved the location, Gracia is the perfect starting point to visit the city but there is also a lot going on just around the flat - plenty to explore, great restaurants, bakeries and bars! Highly recommended!🙏🏻

L´alloggio é molto carino e in una posizione comodossima per girare Barcellona sia a piedi che con i mezzi.
