L'apartament és més vell del que sembla, i no està tot el net que hauria. El sofà amb moltíssimes taques

Ewa was so friendly and welcoming! Our flight ended up being a little bit delayed and she was flexible to meet us when we got there. The apartment was in a great location, clean, and perfect for 4 guests. Be prepared to carry your bags up a few flights of stairs! Overall great experience.

Hôtes très accueillants, disponibles et très aidants. La communication a été fluide avant et pendant le séjour.  Le logement est bien situé et la terrasse sur le toit est un bel atout. Nous avons eu un superbe séjour.

에어컨이 있다고 하지만 지내는 동안 매우 더웠습니다. 에어컨의 성능 개선이 필요합니다. 5일을 머무는데 수건은 1인당 1개만 지급되고, 추가로 수건을 요구했더니 추가 요금을 내야한다고 했습니다. 키친타월, 화장지, 세제, 샴푸 등 모든 것들이 충분치 않았습니다. 이 집을 예약하실 경우 수건을 가지고 가야하며, 세제, 키친타월, 화장지 등이 매우 부족해 별도로 구매해서 사용해야합니다. 화장실의 변기도 부서져 있었습니다. 8월의 더위에 에어컨의 컨디션이 좋지 않은데, 선풍기도 부족했습니다. 3개의 방을 사용하는데 2대의 선풍기만 주었습니다. 그 중 하나는 기능이 좋지도 않았지만. 뒤늦게 추가로 1대의 선풍기를 주긴 했지만 대응이 많이 늦었습니다. 전반적으로 지급한 돈에 비해 부족함이 많은 숙소였습니다. 숙소 정문 앞은 노숙자들이 오줌을 싸서 늘 이상한 냄새가 납니다. 어떤 여행객들이던 그럴싸하게  찍힌 사진에 속지 마시기 바랍니다. 제가 그동안 이용했던 에어비앤비 숙소 중 가성비 측면에서 최악의 숙소입니다. 절대적으로 추천하지 않습니다.
房东非常棒！特别好！下次来还住在这里！还给准备了礼物！房间很新！用品非常齐全！特别感谢房东给延迟退房！非常值得推荐！
Great location! Very walkable. Really enjoyed our stay
Excelente ubicación e instalaciones.

Great hosts, prime location, and great value. Jacques answered many questions prior to our arrival, met us promptly at check-in, had great recommendations and even arranged our taxi back to the airport.
The flat is perfect for up to 5, clean with comfortable beds. It's on the second floor so not far to carry your bags. There is air con if you need it in the summer but the big windows were enough to keep us comfortable in October.
So close to the metro, most sites were 5 stops or less with the Sagrada Familia being the only location requiring a short transfer.
I highly recommend booking Jacques and Aline's flat for you Barcelona experience.
PS - take the "free" Barcelona walking tour by craft tours it's a great way to see the city and we later booked a tapas tour! Super fun time if you like flaming Chorizo and cider! Thanks, Jacques! Great idea!

My family thoroughly enjoyed our experience at Marta's apartment. The place was exactly as described in the listing. The place is walkable to many of Barcelona's top sights (and is close to a metro station to access more distant sights). Despite being in the heart of the city, the place is quiet and peaceful with a delightful back balcony to enjoy morning coffee). Marta was an amazing host who was highly responsive to queries. Check in was easy, and I was very appreciative that Marta let us check in early given our flight arrived in the early morning. Would definitely stay here again.

Points forts de l'appartement :
Appartement confortable
Proximité du métro avec accès rapides aux centres d'intérêts
Nombreux commerces à proximité
Superbe séjour je recommande !

The location is amazing. Many attractions and restaurants in walking distance and only half a block from metro station. Views of Sagrada Familia were unbelievable and it was quiet in the apartment. Perfect for 4 adults, I would highly recommend staying here.
Tutto molto positivo. Consiglio vivamente, per la posizione in pieno centro storico e per la comunicazione con Cesar, da subito pienamente disponibile!

5 stars for this place! It was beautiful and the location was perfect. Very clean and the rooftop views were stunning. Joana and Miguel could not have been better hosts. I highly recommend staying here.
Fácil de llegar con la metro y buses! Alojamiento cómodo. Cerca de la Sagrada Familia
We had a great stay and had a lovely time. Everything this was perfect and we would recommend staying!

This is a comfortable, spacious one bedroom apartment that has everything we needed.  The location is about as central as you can get. For reference, the Apple store is on the same corner - and they certainly take location seriously.  The street in front is busy but the apartment is high enough and set back far enough by the spacious balcony that the noise never bothered me at all.  We were able to walk to everyplace we wanted to go.  Communications with Txell were flawless.  She manages it in a very professional manner.
Excelente lugar, siempre dispuesto a cualquier consulta

Nous avons passé un bon séjour à Barcelone.
L’appartement simple est spacieux et la cour extérieure très agréable.
L’appartement dans le quartier raval est proche des lieux de visite.
Accueil par Virginia très ponctuel.
Je recommande.
Basic, clean, quiet, and Mo was great in aiding us for everything we needed. Would stay again!

Josep was the ultimate host.  He is the most organized of AirBnB hosts I have met in terms of having area information available in his apartment and on his listing.  The apartment's location was 2.5 blocks up the street from the Sagarada Familia in a residential area.  The apartment was spic and span clean.  His cleaner is outstanding.  We cooked breakfast every day and prepared a few snacks. His kitchen was well equipped for just about anything. The apartment is smartly decorated.  The best part was the terrace.  I think we wanted to stay indefinitely so we could enjoy breakfast everyday on the terrace.  It was too bad we didn't have more time in Barcelona to enjoy it as much as we wanted.  Josep's recommendations on restaurants near the apartment were great.  We highly recommend La Paradeta Sagrada for the freshest seafood in the world!  Josep was extremely accommodating answering email's almost instantly.  One day we accidentally locked ourselves out of the apartment had Josep arrived to save the day in less than 10 minutes. Additionally he arranged a taxi to the airport for us. We can't thank him enough for his hospitality!!

El apartamento es ideal para pasar unos días tranquilos en el centro de Barcelona. Zona tranquila, cerca del barrio de Gracia y con metro cerca. Ideal para ir en grupo, tres baños, 5 camas y sofá dan para repartirse sin problema. Los anfitriones han sido muy amables y han sido de ayuda con dudas y demás. La única pega que le puedo poner al apartamento, que no depende de los anfitriones, es que se oye bastante el metro y hay una arqueta en la calle que cuando pasa un coche suena mucho. Por lo demás un apartamento muy bien equipado, limpio y con buena atención a los detalles.
Si vuelvo a BCN en grupo esta será la primera opción para alojamiento.

The apartment is great, and walking distance to everything pretty much!
Check in was a breeze, and we were greeted at the door with directions on how to use the key, what to do upon checkout (take out trash and leave key...easy!), and some tips on what to do or see. It was clean and spacious, and the bathroom was nice, which is always a plus. I accidently stubbed my toe in the shower, and found the first aid kit with a Band-Aid, whew! And they also had things like nail polish remover which can come in handy on week 2 of vacation and messy nails!
It's close to the park, and with the street of tapas near by, we never went hungry!
Directions were easy to follow from the Train station to the metro station to the house, which was great.
We loved the area, the people, and the food, and want to come back again!

We loved our stay in this cute apartment- the best part for us was the balcony out from the bedroom!  The check in system was easy to use and also very handy being electronic. The apartment had everything we needed and the location was fantastic; the main high-street was in short walking distance and we were able to walk to everything else during our stay.
todo genia!
Bernhard and Juan were very lovely and friendly  people. We immediately felt at home at their unique appartment (not far from the Ramblas). When we come back, we will definitely stay here again.

This Deco Apartment was of excellent quality:
- the comfort of the beds
- quality of the linens and towels
- top drawer cleanliness and orderliness
- friendliness and accommodation (storing luggage early, for example)
- quality of appliances and kitchenware
It is pricey and likely set so for small groups to share. We were a family of four, so this was a splurge. However, six adults could very comfortably share this space. The neighbourhood has some very trendy, quality restaurants. It’s very close to the Placa D’Espanja and the Magic Fountain, which are a great way to cap off an evening.
This is probably the best maintained and best run airbnb I’ve stayed in.

The place is nice, but got in “trouble” for having one friend over. The strict neighborhood rules don’t really align with the nature of the location. I recommend staying here if you don’t plan to enjoy the place with new people you meet. All else was perfect, location is great and place is clean.
Hermoso todo
很好 便宜方便 当天定当天就有房

Gostei bastante da hospedagem e certamente voltaria novamente. O Espaco fica numa espécie de hotel, acho válido mencionar… mas é extremamente acolhedor e confortável. Excelente para recarregar as energias de uma viagem exaustiva. O único comentário que eu teria a fazer é que o ar condicionado não desce abaixo de 22 graus (conforme comunicado pelo anfitrião), o que não deixava o apartamento quente, mas às vezes não ficava em uma temperatura tão ideal quanto eu gostaria. Apesar disso, não deixaria de dar 5/5 para a estadia.

Estuve casi dos meses aquí. En general, el piso es muy agradable, con techos alto, cocina nueva, y balcón a calle tranquila por donde entra la luz del sol.
El equipo de Logding fue muy atento. Tuve un problema con el baño y vinieron varias veces hasta lograr arreglarlo
Solo dos cosas a tener en cuenta:
- En diciembre 2023 empezaron a hacer obras en el edificio y el ruido puede llegar a ser muy molesto cuando uno está en la casa
- Hay un olor a humedad del baño que no se terminaba de ir ni con ambientadores ni incieso
Por lo demás todo genial. Tienes todo tipo de tiendas, parques y servicios justo al lado. Y aunque estés en una calle principal, el piso da a una calle tranquila.

Rosa was awesome! She met us right at the Metro stop for the apartment and gave us a warm welcome.  There was also a nice bottle of Rioja for us in the apartment.  Rosa gave us some good advice on how to make the most of our stay in Barcelona.  Very kind person and cute apartment in a convenient location.  I would love to come back and stay again!

points positifs : appartement vaste, super bien placé, parking à proximité pour se garer
points négatifs : une clim était en panne mais faisait du bruit, beaucoup de bruits depuis la rue. vaisselle sale dans le lave vaisselle à notre arrivée. manque de couverts pour 6p. lave vaisselle en panne, l'eau chaude est capricieuse dans les douches, probablement un manque d'entretien.

Marco was great…
Front bedroom was very noisy at night.
Would have been great to have some tea towels in the kitchen…

J’ai adoré mon expérience dans cette hôtel, ça convenait parfaitement à ce que je recherchais. Conforme à la description, je recommande et je reviendrai !
(Super parc juste à côté pour les amateurs de marche ou simplement pour des petites balades matinale)
Excellent location in a beautiful building - perfect for exploring Barcelona!

Great place with a lovely view and useful amenities. Check in and out was easy. Communication was quick and very friendly. The neighborhood is full of great late night options and cozy spots for a great meal. I’d stay again if back in the area in the future.

Great apartment spacius, kleen and had everything we needed.
Isabella was lovly.
Litle noise from traffic.
Buenisimo alojamiento, todo el edificio dedicado a Airbnb. En el primer piso estan las oficinas para recibirte.
Muy buen piso y muy bien ubicado, cerca de una estación de metro y del paseo de gracia.

Stayed here with a friend for almost an entire week, and it was truly home away from home. Incredibly easy to get around by walking, or hailing a taxi as soon as you exit the building. Lots of incredible restaurants within a 2-5 minute walk. Beautiful views from every window, exceptionally clean. Anne was helpful and easy to communicate with. Definitely would return and highly recommend

The apartment is really close to the metro and well equipped, we had a lovely welcome as they got us champagne and breakfast for the next morning. :) We had a great time at the apartment however at night the neighbours were really noisy.

I would not recommend Josep's studio to a friend. On our arrival the cleaning was not done properly we had to remove hair in the bathroom and numerous black spots on the wall. The air conditioning is full of dust making it unusable, as many of the equipments that are broken or about to (coffee machine, chairs). The water boiler broke during our stay.
Only sliding glass doors will separate you from the outside terrace - no proper wall in between - so the studio is freezing at night and very hot during the day.
We did not interact with the main owner for check-in during the stay, it was thought various intermediaries.
The studio is close to various metro and bus stations.

Lovely alternative location, 20 min direct metro available right outside straight into the centre.
We loved the location, very traditional, lovely local food and drinks and much more responsible prices.
Apartment was spotlessly clean, very friendly staff, nice and quiet on an evening… added bonus of a pool on a hot summers day
10 min walk to Camp Nou and the “open top bus” which is highly recommend to get a feel for the city
Wonderful apartment - perfect location, great setup, and very professional management.  Can't say enough good things about this stay...
Alles gut. Die Lage ist es Wert! Der Preis für ein Zimmer mit 4 Schlaf Möglichkeiten ist etwas hoch. Aber die Lage ist eben sehr gut! Schlafkomfort ist gut! Die Betten sind gut! Wir kommen wieder...

The price we paid, for the Airbnb was good compared to the general market. One thing to note is at night it can be noisy, since the entry is right on the street.
The location was very good; a 20 minute walk to sagrada Familia and a 30 minute walk to the Rambla. The fresh market and the supermarket are a 3 minute walk away. Josep recommended a restaurant across the street, Cal Boter. They have a three course special that was delicious. It’s a local hang out.
It is important to book popular attractions along way ahead.
Rosa thank you for being a great host and helping with early check in. Super location. Would definitely use again.

Pasamos unos días en el apartamento, super cómodo y agradable. Muy segura y linda la zona y recorrimos mucho caminando, no tuvimos ningún problema.
Arama se comunicó todo el tiempo para que tengamos una excelente estadía!
Great location, walking distance from everything

Todo ha estado bien. El anuncio es correcto, la habitación es igual a las fotos. La localización es perfecta, hay metro y transportes muy cerca y cafecitos de barrio. Nos hemos sentido a gusto. Gracias!
Все было хорошо, никаких проблем!
Vraiment parfait ! Arrivée très simple, quartier sympa, très bonne localisation. Appartement propre avec tout le confort !
Great location., has a lot of restaurants nearby. Very safe neighborhood.

Best location in Barcelona! Close to the train and unbelievably close to the amazing La Sagrada Familia. As for Marta & Cesc, they were very responsive, caring and super helpful with tips and recommendations (Casa Angela was our go-to for tapas every time). Would love to stay here again :)

Location: perfect. Gràcia is a lovely neighborhood with a great vibe.
Hosts: communicative and friendly
Space: perfect for 2 people. The terrace was a quiet refuge from the hustle and bustle of Barcelona with terrific views of Tibidabo.
One rec: we kept the bathroom window open whenever we took a shower as it retains the moisture. The airflow is key.
We absolutely loved this place. When we come back to Barcelona, we hope that this place is available! Big thanks to Marta and Paul for hosting us!

Loni ist eine tolle Gastgeberin!!! Sie nimmt sich beim Einchecken viel Zeit und gibt tolle Tipps!
Die Wohnung war supersauber, mit Liebe eingerichtet und die Lage ist einfach perfekt! Direkt am Strand aber trotzdem nur knapp 10 Gehminuten vom gemütlichen Gotischen Viertel entfernt!
Der kleine Supermarkt ist direkt um die Ecke und in den Bars rundum kann man toll essen und trinken! Trotzdem ist die Wohnung ruhig und gemütlich !
Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder in genau diese Wohnung !!!!!
